modules.label: roomos_command
modules.tooltip: Execute xCommands on Cisco RoomOS devices

fields.label: arguments
fields.description: Dictionary of arguments to pass to the xCommand.

fields.label: command
fields.description: The xCommand path to execute. Use dot notation, e.g. C(SystemUnit.Boot) or C(Audio.Volume.Set).

fields.label: device id
fields.description: Webex device ID. Required when C(transport=cloud). Falls back to C(roomos_device_id) inventory variable or C(ROOMOS_DEVICE_ID) environment variable.

fields.label: token
fields.description: Webex API bearer token. Required when C(transport=cloud). Falls back to C(roomos_token) inventory variable or C(ROOMOS_TOKEN) environment variable. Use C(lookup('env', 'WEBEX_TOKEN')) or Ansible Vault — never hardcode tokens.

fields.label: validate certs
fields.description: Whether to validate TLS certificates. Most RoomOS devices use self-signed certificates, so this defaults to C(false). Set to C(true) in production environments with proper CA-signed certificates.

modules.label: roomos_config
modules.tooltip: Set xConfigurations on Cisco RoomOS devices

fields.label: config
fields.description: Dictionary of xConfiguration path/value pairs to set. Use dot notation for paths, e.g. C(NetworkServices.NTP.Server1.Address).

fields.label: device id
fields.description: Webex device ID. Required when C(transport=cloud). Falls back to C(roomos_device_id) inventory variable or C(ROOMOS_DEVICE_ID) environment variable.

fields.label: failure mode
fields.description: How to handle individual config path failures. C(fail) fails the entire task on any invalid path. C(warn) applies valid configs and warns about failures. C(ignore) silently skips invalid paths.

fields.label: token
fields.description: Webex API bearer token. Required when C(transport=cloud). Falls back to C(roomos_token) inventory variable or C(ROOMOS_TOKEN) environment variable. Use C(lookup('env', 'WEBEX_TOKEN')) or Ansible Vault — never hardcode tokens.

fields.label: validate certs
fields.description: Whether to validate TLS certificates. Most RoomOS devices use self-signed certificates, so this defaults to C(false). Set to C(true) in production environments with proper CA-signed certificates.

modules.label: roomos_status
modules.tooltip: Query xStatus values from Cisco RoomOS devices

fields.label: device id
fields.description: Webex device ID. Required when C(transport=cloud). Falls back to C(roomos_device_id) inventory variable or C(ROOMOS_DEVICE_ID) environment variable.

fields.label: on missing
fields.description: How to handle status paths that don't exist on the device. C(warn) returns null and emits a warning. C(fail) causes the module to fail. C(ignore) silently returns null.

fields.label: paths
fields.description: List of xStatus paths to query. Use dot notation, e.g. C(Standby.State) or C(SystemUnit.Uptime).

fields.label: token
fields.description: Webex API bearer token. Required when C(transport=cloud). Falls back to C(roomos_token) inventory variable or C(ROOMOS_TOKEN) environment variable. Use C(lookup('env', 'WEBEX_TOKEN')) or Ansible Vault — never hardcode tokens.

fields.label: validate certs
fields.description: Whether to validate TLS certificates. Most RoomOS devices use self-signed certificates, so this defaults to C(false). Set to C(true) in production environments with proper CA-signed certificates.
